name: gridfinity-refresh-fs
description: Refresh a Feature Studio that is already built into a document: re-commit dev/fixtures-capture/gridfinity-baseplate.fs into the OPEN document's Feature Studio so the already-inserted custom-feature rows recompute from the corrected source. This project creates no document and adds no feature row (apply=false), so the target's feature tree keeps exactly the rows it had. The deploy step reads the source from disk, so the committed bytes are the packaged file, not a transcription. Success is verified afterwards with browser_get_fs_compile_status, browser_get_partstudio_features and a fresh STEP export; the runner cannot report it, because TOOL_OUTCOME_KEYS requires 'built' from browser_deploy_and_apply_featurescript and an apply=false call does not build anything.
